pre_specification_record: No verifiable prespecification record identified; timestamps show exploratory checks before expansion to additional seeds, not preregistration.
full_score_method: CDF-squared trapezoid integral, not closed-form and not 199-quantile; Gaussian [-4,8], nonnegative distributions [0,8]; 4000+1000 grid points.
twcrps_sample_population: All 3939 test cases for every threshold, not conditional observed-wet/upper samples.
brier_wet_event: y>0.1 in source; on these test targets identical event set to y>=0.1.

bootstrap.aggregation: arithmetic mean of five per-case scores first, then paired resampling; not mean predictions
bootstrap.seed_t: separate paired five-seed mean-difference Student t, df4
bootstrap.limitation: Retains 9 extra observations (0.2285%); non-circular endpoints have lower sampling weight. Does not implement standard resample length n; no automatic inference that effect is negligible. Same-index truncated-n sensitivity in paired_full_verification.csv is diagnostic only; formal CSV remains unchanged.
